{{Top|leg}}
'''Kraemr''' was a subscriber to, and commenter on, "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]." In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Kraemr commented on the entry for the [[NR-5 Series Repair Droid]], warning that a company called [[Tredwall]] was producing knock-off versions of the NR-5.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Kraemr commented on the entry for the [[G-2RD series guard droid]], relating a story where a G-2RD killed their previous partner while attempting to break an impound lock placed on their [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Kraemr did three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] in prison before managing to escape.<ref name="CDD14">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
